$Clone.description: Clone a cooked BuildingPieceData asset. The clone receives a new RuneSchema identity and remains a separate build-menu entry.

AddTo.description: Optional explicit placement(s). When omitted, RuneSchema appends the clone to every page/collection containing its $Clone source.

Asset.description: Register an existing BuildingPieceData asset; use $Clone when changing the actor or cost.

Overrides.description: Optional direct-building presentation, placement, shelter and station-row overrides. Omitted fields preserve cooked values; every requested runtime target is verified before registration.

Health.description: HealthComponent defaults. On $Clone, requires a private cooked BuildableActor.

Profile.description: Existing row in the building's cooked placement-profile table. PropProfile is the standard terrain-capable station profile.

RegionBlockList.description: Advanced native GameplayTagQuery object. Prefer copying a known-good FModel value.

RequiresFoundation.description: False selects Profile, or PropProfile when Profile is omitted. True requires an explicit verified profile.

RequiresRoof.description: Compatibility alias. True selects InteractInShelterOnly; false selects InteractAnywhere.

RequiresShelter.description: Compatibility alias. True selects InteractInShelterOnly; false selects InteractAnywhere.

AcceptedFuels.description: Mutate the processing row's AcceptedFuels array. Append preserves native fuels; authors should not repeat a fuel already present. Replace and Clear are explicit.

Rate.description: ProcessingRate multiplier on the single station row that references this building. Recipe Min/MaxProcessingTime still takes precedence for per-recipe duration.

StartingFuelItem.description: Optional starting FuelItemData object path; null preserves an explicitly empty starter slot.

Shelter.description: Actor-component settings. On $Clone, these require Properties.BuildableActor to name a private cooked actor.

Snapping.description: BuildingSnapComponent defaults. On $Clone, requires a private cooked BuildableActor.

Profile.description: Existing DT_StabilityProfile row used as the source.

Properties.description: Reflected BuildingPieceData overrides. PersistenceID, InternalName, BuildingPieceDataIndex and Requirements are managed and rejected here. A BuildableActor override must be a cooked BP_BaseBuilding_BaseActor child.

Requirements.description: Complete replacement build cost. Every item must resolve before the clone is registered.

Unlock.description: Session-unlock the separate cloned entry. False does not revoke an unlock already persisted by the game.

$declaration.description: Ownership declaration for PAK-cooked persistent content. RuneSchema verifies the live asset identity before recording it.

InternalName.description: Optional cooked InternalName assertion. When omitted, RuneSchema reads it from the asset.

Kind.description: Optional assertion; the containing loader determines this kind.

Path.description: Exact cooked object path shipped by the mod PAK.

PersistenceID.description: Canonical PersistenceID baked into the cooked asset. RuneSchema verifies it against the loaded object.
